title: ONE PIXEL WALK BOB
why: Job 86c asks for a one pixel bob at the existing timings and a muzzle within one world unit of the vector muzzle. The shipped body bobs by up to four pixels and its shoulder is two units too high. Its old muzzle check measures only the gun offset, missing the world placement.
now: The pixel torso breathes and bobs between two adjacent pixel rows. The gun shoulder is back at the existing muzzle height.

edits.replacement: var PXB={W:36,H:50,AX:19,AY:51,PV:20,TARGET:50}; /* v28.xx (cw-cx-pixpose): the pixel shoulder uses the existing 20 world unit muzzle height */
bob=pxBob(ph,moving); /* v28.xx (cw-cx-pixpose): his a11 B bounce, one art pixel at the existing stride and breath timings */
